import re

CLS = re.compile(r'^(?P<kind>\w+) \[ <(?P<origin>[^>]*)> (?P<mods>.*?)\b(?P<type>class|interface|trait|enum) (?P<name>\S+)(?: (?P<rest>.*?))? \] \{')
SEC = re.compile(r'^- (?P<section>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]*?) \[(?P<count>\d+)\] \{$')
METH = re.compile(r'^Method \[ <(?P<origin>[^>]*)> (?P<mods>.*?)\bmethod (?P<name>\S+) \] \{')
PARAM = re.compile(r'^Parameter #(?P<pos>\d+) \[ <(?P<req>\w+)> (?:(?P<type>.*?) )?(?P<name>[&.]*\$\w+)(?: = (?P<default>.*?))? \]$')
RET = re.compile(r'^- (?P<kind>Tentative return|Return) \[ (?P<type>.*?) \]$')
MEM = re.compile(r'^(?P<kind>Constant|Property) \[ (?P<decl>.*?) \](?: \{ (?P<value>.*) \})?$')

def parse(lines):
    cls = []
    cls_lines = []
    sections = []
    sec_lines = []
    methods = []
    meth_lines = []
    params = []
    par_lines = []
    members = []
    mem_lines = []
    skip = []
    section = ''
    method = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        m = CLS.match(s)
        if m:
            cls.append({'Kind': m.group('kind'), 'Origin': m.group('origin'), 'Modifiers': m.group('mods').strip(), 'Type': m.group('type'), 'Name': m.group('name'), 'Extends/Implements': m.group('rest') or ''})
            cls_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = METH.match(s)
        if m:
            method = {'Section': section, 'Origin': m.group('origin'), 'Modifiers': m.group('mods').strip(), 'Method': m.group('name'), 'Return': '', 'Return kind': ''}
            methods.append(method)
            meth_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = PARAM.match(s)
        if m:
            params.append({'Method': method['Method'] if method else '', 'Position': int(m.group('pos')), 'Requirement': m.group('req'), 'Type': m.group('type') or '', 'Name': m.group('name'), 'Default': m.group('default') or ''})
            par_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = RET.match(s)
        if m and method is not None:
            method['Return'] = m.group('type')
            method['Return kind'] = m.group('kind')
            meth_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = SEC.match(s)
        if m:
            if m.group('section') == 'Parameters':
                skip.append(i)
            else:
                section = m.group('section')
                method = None
                sections.append({'Section': section, 'Count': int(m.group('count'))})
                sec_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = MEM.match(s)
        if m:
            members.append({'Section': section, 'Kind': m.group('kind'), 'Declaration': m.group('decl'), 'Value': m.group('value') or ''})
            mem_lines.append(i)
            continue
        if s in ('{', '}') or s.startswith('@@'):
            skip.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if cls:
        blocks.append({'name': 'class', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': cls_lines, 'records': [cls[0]]})
    if sections:
        blocks.append({'name': 'sections', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': sec_lines, 'records': sections})
    if members:
        blocks.append({'name': 'members', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': mem_lines, 'records': members})
    if methods:
        blocks.append({'name': 'methods', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': meth_lines, 'records': methods})
    if params:
        blocks.append({'name': 'parameters', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': par_lines, 'records': params})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
